title: Battle of Rain
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Rain", at revision 1370587087, opens: "The Battle of Rain took place on 15 April 1632 near Rain in Bavaria during the Thirty Years' War. A Swedish army under Gustavus Adolphus of Sweden defeated a Catholic League force led by Johann Tserclaes, Count of Tilly, who later died of wounds received in the battle." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q703436, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1632 battle of the thirty years' war". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
